description: The resources one operation holds open at the same time; when it changes between runs, it decides between nested `with` and an `ExitStack`.
Releasing at a known point and in a known order, as `__exit__` and `ExitStack` do; garbage collection gives neither.
How failures are represented: a class hierarchy callers can catch by type, error codes, or plain strings.
The original exception linked with `raise ... from`, plus identifiers added with `add_note` while the message stays stable.
